subject.title: [Feature]: Ali bailian coding plan support ( thinking/reasoning enabled )

question: Should OpenClaw officially enable Bailian/Qwen Coding Plan reasoning for bundled models and custom `bailian` providers now, and which models/regions should be treated as supported?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the permanent support boundary depends on vendor/model proof and whether maintainers want this in the bundled Qwen provider, custom-provider compatibility, or both.

options.title: Land Verified Slices
options.body: Review the open custom-provider and catalog PRs as separate verified slices, then close this issue only after merged coverage or an explicit documented remainder.

options.title: Defer Broad Support
options.body: Keep current behavior and require stronger Alibaba model-by-model proof before changing bundled catalog reasoning flags.

options.title: Document Custom Config Only
options.body: Avoid bundled catalog changes and publish a supported custom-provider recipe for users with verified Coding Plan reasoning access.

recommendation.title: Land Verified Slices
recommendation.body: Review the open custom-provider and catalog PRs as separate verified slices, then close this issue only after merged coverage or an explicit documented remainder.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger introduced the provider surface and the live prior review discussion from steipete already routed the product boundary decision.
